scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names contracts,web,api,orchestrator,data-worker "pnpm --filter @choicemind/contracts dev" "pnpm --filter @choicemind/web dev" "pnpm --filter @choicemind/api dev" "pnpm --filter @choicemind/orchestrator dev" "uv run --project services/data-worker uvicorn data_worker.app:app --app-dir services/data-worker/src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3300"
scripts.lint: biome lint apps/api/src apps/orchestrator/src apps/web/src apps/web/tests apps/web/playwright.config.ts packages/contracts/src && uv run --project services/data-worker ruff check services/data-worker/src services/data-worker/tests
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @choicemind/contracts build && pnpm --recursive --if-present test && uv run --project services/data-worker pytest -c services/data-worker/pyproject.toml services/data-worker/tests
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:utf8 && pnpm build
